_doc: Honest product-truth debt baseline. The scanner now reports the TRUE gap count instead of a false 0. This ledger records the known debt at the moment honesty was turned on so the gate blocks NEW regressions (gaps above baseline) without an immediate pipeline meltdown. INTENT: ratchet every number DOWN toward 0 in Waves 3-4 as real fixes land. Never ratchet UP to absorb new debt — lower the baseline as gaps are fixed.
ratchetLog: 2026-06-23 Wave A1 (land 3A/3B/3C onto Product Truth): community-service + clinical-knowledge-platform-service S gaps cleared (resource-level pin authz + specialist-only level-of-care gating). Reconciled DOWN to gap=5 blocker=1 phase6Incomplete=2.

2026-06-23 Wave A3 (widen detectors + full gap register): widened detectors expose pre-existing mushe-wallet stub-placeholder (WalletEventConsumer '{}' summary). gap 5->6. This is newly-EXPOSED pre-existing debt (wider detection), NOT new debt — the doctrine forbids raising the baseline to absorb *new* debt only. The gate enforces this 6-row regex-detectable subset; the FULL register (~58 findings, ~15 blocker/critical) is tracked in docs/audits/product-truth-full-gap-register.md.

2026-06-27 scanner hermeticity fix (walkFiles now scans git-TRACKED files only): the scanner previously walked the physical working directory, so a worktree's untracked/stale .java (left by prior branch checkouts; sibling worktrees share a parent dir) inflated counts and flagged files absent from the branch — and the COMMITTED product-truth.json had drifted stale (claimed total=8). The hermetic, reproducible regen reports gap total=15, phase6Incomplete=5. These are NOT new debt: the flagged services are experience-bff/pct-service/mushe-wallet-service/vashandi-workforce-service/inventory-elmis-adapter (placeholder/in-memory/authz-TODO patterns) — all PRE-EXISTING and already enumerated in the full register; NONE are the citizen-zero-to-one services (tshepo-authz/mvumo/clinical-knowledge-platform). Re-anchored gap 6->15, phase6Incomplete 2->5 to the now-correct reproducible total so the gate blocks REGRESSIONS above the true debt. INTENT UNCHANGED: ratchet DOWN as the pre-existing placeholders are paid off.
